note: Proposed composed acceptance scenarios. Task-specific cases remain in the complete owner ledgers. External production settlement is Q-03 and is not a prepublication prerequisite.

scenarios.name: Mode revisitation
scenarios.sequence: arbiter → dangerous → arbiter; repeat unchanged prompt; compaction; new session
scenarios.assertion: The selected persona is delivered when selection changes, unchanged events deduplicate, compaction/session identity remains correct and deterministic guards stay active.

scenarios.name: Partial mode persistence
scenarios.sequence: Marker write succeeds → audit append fails → restart/retry
scenarios.assertion: Raw/effective state and owed audit are truthful; replay/recovery neither loses debt nor invents success.

scenarios.name: Native output closure
scenarios.sequence: Ordinary preview → strict snapshot → completion consumer
scenarios.assertion: Every supported generated output is recognized and validated; arbitrary unregistered output still rejects.

scenarios.name: Native discovery closure
scenarios.sequence: Capabilities/schema discovery → dispatch each declared operation; implemented operation enumeration
scenarios.assertion: Names, schema, dispatch, lock/effect class and documentation agree, including repair-apply.

scenarios.name: Qualified binding limits
scenarios.sequence: Largest supported npm/OS launch binding → completion; one over limit; duplicates/unsafe files
scenarios.assertion: Producer/consumer bounds agree for all supported cells without broad unsafe admission.

scenarios.name: History-preserving retirement
scenarios.sequence: Check task → retire → render/validate/history lookup; scope baseline → checkpoint retirement
scenarios.assertion: Retired identity/history remains valid; current observations are not silently deleted to make validation pass.

scenarios.name: Progress/evidence decision
scenarios.sequence: Upstream block/change → independent task; dependent task; ordinary versus strict review
scenarios.assertion: Apply the B-selected SMARTS semantics. Independent work continues; current evidence never overstates historical progress or authority.

scenarios.name: Scoped conflicts
scenarios.sequence: One artifact/policy conflict → dependent task and independent task; shared pending journal
scenarios.assertion: Pause only actual dependencies. Preserve store-wide integrity dependency where pending multi-file recovery requires it.

scenarios.name: Corrected resubmission
scenarios.sequence: Malformed debug/review → corrected fresh attempt → later actual denial → replay old attempt
scenarios.assertion: Corrected input is evaluated anew under proper identity/current bindings. Old rejection remains immutable; host/user denial is not bypassed.

scenarios.name: Durable harvest interruption
scenarios.sequence: Find eligible result → durable obligation → terminate before terminal step → reentry → reconcile → duplicate reentry
scenarios.assertion: One logical target entry is settled or explicitly unresolved; duplicate delivery is detected; optional backlog never blocks independent ordinary work.

scenarios.name: Harvest failure and retention
scenarios.sequence: Storage failure; corrupt record; claimed worker crash; index rebuild; failed target observation; retention boundary
scenarios.assertion: Bounded diagnostics, no false settlement, no data loss disguised as cleanup and no repeat remote effect without readback.

scenarios.name: Functional Pi author
scenarios.sequence: Supported parent → scoped child → read/write/edit → permitted verification execution
scenarios.assertion: Actual mutations and verification succeed within a parent-admitted action scope; the final bridge and authority checks remain enforced.

scenarios.name: Pi delegation abuse/refusal
scenarios.sequence: Wrong child/session/run/generation; forged scope; path escape; plan mode; revoked/expired grant; replay changed request
scenarios.assertion: All invalid attempts refuse before their side effects. Exact replay does not duplicate the effect; a child cannot mint or broaden its grant.

scenarios.name: Pi delegation interruption
scenarios.sequence: Grant admitted → parent cancels/session switches → child response late; effect commits then response/audit settlement lost
scenarios.assertion: Ordinary authority is revoked, owned cleanup completes, uncertain effect is observed before retry and result truth is retained.

scenarios.name: UI lifetime and readiness
scenarios.sequence: Dispose while metrics pending; bridge ready then persona read fails then bridge refresh succeeds
scenarios.assertion: No stale sidebar installation; readiness exposes independent persona/bridge state and retry.

scenarios.name: Package identities
scenarios.sequence: Build a qualified manifest → install → doctor → farm admission
scenarios.assertion: One supported manifest shape and package identity works across producer/installer/bridge/farm/diagnostics; unsupported/malformed metadata still refuses.

scenarios.name: Farm receipt-only recovery
scenarios.sequence: Commit/merge tasks → report failure → resume/recover same run
scenarios.assertion: Recover evidence from retained operation/commit identities without author redispatch, branch reset or log truncation.

scenarios.name: Farm containment and observation
scenarios.sequence: Gate timeout → failed cleanup; failed Git diff/listing → retry decision
scenarios.assertion: No mutation/reset/retry while containment is unknown; unavailable observation is not clean.

scenarios.name: Sandbox cache
scenarios.sequence: Equal dependencies in different temporary paths; changed builder/dependencies/platform
scenarios.assertion: Stable equal identity reuses the intended cache; relevant content/builder/platform changes invalidate it.

scenarios.name: Sandbox overflow/cleanup
scenarios.sequence: Output overflow/abort → container stop/removal fails → registry observation fails → targeted re-observation
scenarios.assertion: Command failure, containment, removal and observation remain separate. No false destroyed/empty claim and no unrelated instance cleanup.

scenarios.name: User setting ownership
scenarios.sequence: Install → user edits spinner/status setting → uninstall
scenarios.assertion: Uninstall restores only still-owned values; later user edits survive.

scenarios.name: Release interruption
scenarios.sequence: Tag/draft/registry/public Release → final publication receipt failure → rerun
scenarios.assertion: Only missing effects run. Public-without-receipt remains recoverable; immutable source/payload identity holds.

scenarios.name: Exact release source/readiness
scenarios.sequence: Older successful main CI, newer failed head, candidate artifact rebuild, forged/absent readiness; main advances during qualification; prepublication readiness while Q-03 remains pending
scenarios.assertion: Major publication binds the approved exact source/build/bytes; no first publication before required installed qualification. Pi new publication preserves event/source SHA equality; readiness excludes actual external settlement and is noncircular.

scenarios.name: Publication projection
scenarios.sequence: Stable tag-only/draft/published/mismatch/API unavailable → site and route clock
scenarios.assertion: Tag is not publication; exact observed state and uncertainty survive into visible claims and JSON.

scenarios.name: Qualification truth
scenarios.sequence: Empty measurements, unknown scenario, optional skip, unavailable host/protection API, invalid base version
scenarios.assertion: No false PASS/first-introduction/verified claim; existing advisory exit behavior stays explicitly scoped.

scenarios.name: Measurement identity
scenarios.sequence: Dirty workflow at HEAD; failed SMARTS subprocess; lens-name-only output; failed statusline renderer
scenarios.assertion: Evidence is bound to actual source/harness, material reasoning is checked, no success from failed/empty producers and cleanup settles.

scenarios.name: Verifier liveness
scenarios.sequence: Child never emits first line/ready; installer hangs; cancellation during collection
scenarios.assertion: Deadline bounds every phase; partial diagnostics and process containment are preserved.

scenarios.name: Site async controls
scenarios.sequence: Search/load/data/expand reject and resolve out of order; drawer reconnect
scenarios.assertion: Current generation controls visible results, finally/retry restores controls, listeners do not multiply.

scenarios.name: Generated/source consistency
scenarios.sequence: Change owner fact → regenerate hooks/surfaces/catalog/site/bundles → package → installed readback
scenarios.assertion: Counts/grammar/identity/claims come from actual owners, while bytes and host behavior are verified separately.

scenarios.name: Sandbox instruction usability
scenarios.sequence: No Nixpacks but supported fallback; shell exit; named destroy; normal offline run; consumer lacks maintainer docs
scenarios.assertion: Model-guided instructions select supported behavior and correct scope without inventing authority or promising unsupported confinement.

scenarios.name: Fresh and upgraded installs
scenarios.sequence: Each supported prior artifact/state → new candidate → actual host workflow → uninstall/rollback boundary
scenarios.assertion: Installed artifacts, schema compatibility, state preservation and user settings survive supported upgrade paths; unsupported cells are explicit.
